Iris: quick sync  we need a clear origination + rollback policy for config applies (flags, routing, quotas).
Marc: agreed. proposal: every config carries provenance fields `origin`, `author`, `ticket` in the manifest. console/api writes these on create.
Chen: auto-rollback heuristic idea: if within 10m of apply we see p99_up > 1% OR error_rate_up > 0.5% for 3 consecutive 1m windows -> auto-rollback to previous snapshot.
Tara: UX: console should show an inline "Revert" CTA next to an applied snapshot. clicking it should open a modal that explains auto-rollback criteria and requires a short reason if forced.
Iris: also add a soft-lock: if a snapshot was created by CI/origin=ci, require a human-owner confirmation for prod apply.
Marc: API shape: POST /v1/configs/{id}/apply {"snapshot_id":"s-123","preflight_id":"pf-9","force":false,"reason":null}. For force=true we require `ticket` and `approver`.
Chen: telemetry plan: emit counters `config_apply_attempt_total{result="applied|blocked|forced"}` and `config_rollback_auto_total`. Also a gauge `config_postapply_slo_delta_p99`.
SRE: nudge on cardinality: do NOT include snapshot_id as a metric label. keep snapshot_id in logs/traces only. metrics can carry `snapshot_tag=shorthash` if needed.
Iris: good. sample manifest we want in audit logs (structured):
```
manifest: {
  "id": "cfg-987",
  "snapshot_id": "s-123",
  "origin": "console",
  "author": "iris",
  "ticket": "PROD-42"
}
```
Tara: sample log lines for standardization:
```
cfg_apply snapshot_hash=5f3a initiator=iris result=applied preflight_id=pf-9 affected_routes=12
cfg_rollback_auto snapshot_hash=5f2d triggered_by=auto reason=\"p99_up_1.3%\" reverted_to=s-122 initiator=system
```
Marc: guardrail: if an auto-rollback happens, create a P0 draft with attached traces & preview + page oncall if rollback count > 1 for same config within 24h.
Chen: we should allow a short TTL window where force-apply is allowed by ops (e.g., 15min after rollback) to avoid flip-flop. after TTL, require full preflight again.
SRE: also emit an event `config_revert_requested` when user hits Revert CTA; track who clicked, timestamp, and link to preview. keep those events in audit store for 90d.
ops-bot: created ticket CFG-AUD-101 and assigned to @Iris, @SRE https://tickets/redwood/CFG-AUD-101 :white_check_mark:
Iris: next steps: Marc to add provenance fields to manifest + API, Chen to implement rollback detector, Tara to update console mock and Revert flow, SRE to review metric schema. follow-up in CFG-AUD-101. :rocket:
